checks.name: BUG-AN-001 analytics semantics
checks.details: index.html binds sts_upload_start to fileInput click. Actual: event fires when picker opens, including cancel/no file. Expected: an upload-start event should represent an actual upload attempt; v0.8 has no upload transport. Risk: analytics/CRO funnel inflation and incorrect interpretation. Priority P1 analytics/CRO. Evidence: fileInput click handler calls trackGoal(GOALS.uploadStart), while change validation occurs later and submitStsToServer is a rejecting stub. Proposed fix: rename/redefine the event as a picker interaction, or move a semantically appropriate event to successful local file selection; reserve upload_start for future real transport. Status: found/documented, not code-fixed.
